lines.text: Every season, farmers bet their savings on the weather.
Near Bambey, Senegal, NASA records show season rain swinging from three hundred to nearly a thousand millimetres.
And the usual plan often costs more than the cash on hand.
Field Shift fuses twenty-five years of NASA Earth data with what farmers know: their crops, soil and budget.
It replays every past season to find rotations they can actually afford, and explains why.
Field Shift. From space to soil.
